Frederiksberg is a Danish municipality tracked in national healthcare quality monitoring, specifically within the annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database. These reports evaluate clinical quality indicators across all 98 municipalities in Denmark to facilitate local benchmarking and quality improvement in the healthcare system. 

In the 2022–2023 reporting period, Frederiksberg's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among patients with atrial fibrillation was utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, a metric focused on preventing ischemic strokes through anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. The specific municipal data for this indicator recorded 19 stroke events out of a cohort of 2,118 patients [^src1]. Furthermore, within the organizational framework of the Danish healthcare system, the municipality is categorized under the broader [[sundhedsklynger|Sundhedsklyngerne]] system, specifically being identified as part of the "Sundhedsklynge Byen Frederiksberg" (Health Cluster City of Frederiksberg) [^src2]. 

Because the available documentation for this specific entity is limited to its statistical inclusion in these clinical reports, further administrative or historical details are not covered in the current corpus.
